WITH daily AS (
    SELECT
        fs.DateKey,
        ps.ProductCategoryKey,
        sum(fs.SalesAmount) AS daily_sales,
        d.CalendarDayOfWeekLabel IN ('Saturday', 'Sunday') AS is_weekend
    FROM retail.FactSales fs
    JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON fs.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
    JOIN retail.DimDate d ON fs.DateKey = d.DateKey
    GROUP BY fs.DateKey, ps.ProductCategoryKey, is_weekend
)
SELECT
    pc.ProductCategoryName,
    avgIf(daily_sales, is_weekend)     AS avg_weekend_day_sales,
    avgIf(daily_sales, NOT is_weekend) AS avg_weekday_sales,
    avgIf(daily_sales, is_weekend) / avgIf(daily_sales, NOT is_weekend) AS weekend_to_weekday_ratio
FROM daily
JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON daily.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY weekend_to_weekday_ratio DESC
